summary.why_no_unique_count: Source-instance count is exact for mapped garment panels, but is NOT a unique-design count. Many constructions recur with altered fit or art. No visual duplicate is asserted solely from identical names. Additional model-only hero/back artwork may be variants of existing panels and remains separately flagged for inspection.

method: All29 boards reopened visually; read-only comparison to78-product snapshot and representative images. Source instances are preserved to avoid lost designs. No Cartesian colour products generated. All missing views refer to snapshot before current repair.
